cases.name: Doris Sue Brock
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She served for the last twenty four years at Jordan Christian Academy, where she touched many lives.  She loved her students very much, and would make a difference in their lives.  Doris was a faithful member of Jordan Baptist Church and will be greatly missed.  She was very adventurous and wasn’t scared to live life to the fullest.  Even at age 65, she went skydiving in Hawaii…… to know Doris was to love her, she showed kindness and love to everyone she came in contact with."
cases.narrative: On 2/22/2024, her body was found during a welfare check after she didn't show up for work.
